reviewScope: Internal functional/numerical review, not independent human expert, official curriculum, physical-device/touch/FPS or printer certification. Discrete token counting for selected known H–Ar isotope references and neutral ground-state shell occupancy. Partial tokens are an unfinished diagram, not an identified physical ion/nucleus. No isotope abundance, measured atomic mass, binding energy, nuclear size, physical assembly, electron position, electron speed or quantum wavefunction. Mass number is a nucleon count. Nuclear packing, colours, shell radii and arcs are arbitrary display choices; shell rings show occupancy, not electron trajectories. Comparison always uses completed neutral reference targets. Exact elementary-charge constant with floating-point representation; integer counts exact. Saved observations require completed neutral construction; timed record eligibility also requires verified stage and paused playback.
